sip coffee: Every morning my grandfather likes to sip coffee slowly on the balcony while reading the newspaper.
每天早上我爺爺喜歡一邊在陽台上看報紙，一邊慢慢啜飲咖啡。
sip at the wine: At the wedding dinner, she only wanted to sip at the wine, taking tiny mouthfuls to be polite.
在婚宴上，她只想小口喝酒，為了禮貌只喝一點點。
take a sip: The soup was very hot, so I could only take a sip before waiting for it to cool down.
湯非常燙，所以我只能喝一小口，然後等它變涼。
be sited near the river: The new public library will be sited near the river, so readers can enjoy the water view from the windows.
新的公共圖書館將位於河邊，讀者可以從窗戶欣賞水景。
site a factory: The company plans to site a factory close to the port so that it can ship goods abroad more cheaply.
這家公司計畫在港口附近選址建廠，這樣就能更便宜地把貨物運往國外。
a construction site: Workers at a construction site must wear hard hats to protect their heads from falling objects.
工地的工人必須戴安全帽，以保護頭部不被掉落物擊中。
on site: A nurse is always on site at the factory in case any worker gets hurt during the day.
工廠裡總是有一位護士在現場，以防有工人在白天受傷。
size up the situation: When the fire broke out, the firefighters took a moment to size up the situation before rushing inside.
火災發生時，消防員先花了一點時間評估情勢，然後才衝進去。
size up an opponent: Good tennis players often use the first few games to size up an opponent and find his weak points.
優秀的網球選手常利用前幾局來打量對手，找出他的弱點。
size someone up: When I walked into the meeting room, the new boss looked at me carefully, as if trying to size me up.
當我走進會議室時，新老闆仔細地看著我，好像在打量我這個人。
cut down to size: The proud champion was cut down to size when a young unknown player beat him easily in the first round.
當一位沒沒無聞的年輕選手在第一輪輕鬆擊敗這位驕傲的冠軍時，他被挫了銳氣。
one size fits all: Teaching is not one size fits all, because every student learns in a different way and at a different speed.
教學不是一體適用的，因為每個學生學習的方式和速度都不同。
sketch out a plan: Before the meeting, let's quickly sketch out a plan on paper and fill in the details later.
開會前，我們先在紙上快速勾勒計畫，細節之後再補上。
sketch a portrait: The street artist only needed ten minutes to sketch a portrait of me with a pencil.
這位街頭藝術家只需要十分鐘就用鉛筆幫我畫了一張素描肖像。
sketch in the details: After drawing the outline of the house, the artist began to sketch in the details with a soft pencil.
畫好房子的輪廓後，這位畫家開始用軟鉛筆補充細節。
a rough sketch: The designer drew a rough sketch of the new logo on a napkin to show us her idea.
設計師在餐巾紙上畫了新商標的草圖，向我們展示她的想法。
skip class: If you skip class too often, the teacher will call your parents and you may fail the course.
如果你太常翹課，老師會打電話給你的父母，而且你可能會被當掉。
skip a meal: Doctors say you should not skip a meal when you are busy, because you will feel tired and hungry later.
醫生說，即使很忙也不應該不吃一餐，因為之後你會覺得又累又餓。
skip the details: We are running out of time, so let's skip the details and go straight to the main point.
我們時間快不夠了，所以略過細節，直接講重點吧。
skip town: The man borrowed money from all his neighbors and then decided to skip town in the middle of the night.
這名男子向所有鄰居借錢，然後決定在半夜逃離城鎮。
skip a grade: Because she was far ahead of her classmates in every subject, the school let her skip a grade.
因為她每一科都遠遠領先同學，學校讓她跳級。
skip breakfast: Many students skip breakfast because they get up late, but then they cannot focus in class.
許多學生因為晚起而不吃早餐，結果上課時無法專心。
skip ahead: If the introduction of the video is boring, you can press this button to skip ahead thirty seconds.
如果影片的開頭很無聊，你可以按這個按鈕往前跳三十秒。
slam the door: After the argument with his mother, the angry boy ran to his room to slam the door loudly.
和媽媽吵完架後，那個生氣的男孩跑回房間，大聲地甩門。
slam the government: Many newspapers slam the government for its slow response to the flood, calling it careless and lazy.
許多報紙抨擊政府對水災反應遲緩，稱其粗心又怠惰。
slam on the brakes: When a child suddenly ran into the street, the bus driver had to slam on the brakes.
當一個孩子突然衝到街上時，公車司機不得不猛踩煞車。
slam a proposal: Angry residents were quick to slam a proposal to build a garbage dump near the school, calling it a terrible idea.
憤怒的居民很快就痛批在學校附近蓋垃圾場的提案，稱其為糟糕的主意。
slam dunk: The tall player jumped high and made a powerful slam dunk, and the whole crowd stood up and cheered.
那位高個子球員高高躍起，完成一記強力灌籃，全場觀眾都站起來歡呼。
